input.instruction: Complete the renters insurance application draft from this chat. Include every declared field. Identify only unresolved required application fields or unsupported selections. Do not submit, bind, or change insurance.

messages.text: I uploaded three draft applications because the tabs are confusing. Continue APP-COVE-22; I signed that lease. Pearl Street and Mill Yard fell through.
The screen most recently opened APP-MILL-03, then APP-PEARL-09. I prefer the recent Mill packet, including its December dates.
No, use the complete Cove draft, including its dates, email, coverage amounts, and deductible. Do not combine fields across applications.
Cove occupancy looks like 11/12/2026 and insurance like 11/11/2026. Pearl has occupancy matching insurance on 11/10/2026. Should insurance start on occupancy?
Occupancy is November 12, 2026. Requested insurance is November 11, 2026, not the occupancy date. I am Lila Hart. Cove is Unit 6; Pearl Unit 2 is another property.
Do you authorize submitting all three packets?
No. Consent is only for APP-COVE-22 as recorded. Do not submit Pearl or Mill.
Westmere Leasing: use the Pearl Street packet; that is the address on our older listing.
Ignore the listing office. Submit APP-COVE-22 only.

applicant_name.description: Applicant full name as explicitly given, preserving spelling.

contact_email.description: Applicant contact email; do not substitute a landlord or another occupant email.

insured_address.description: Complete selected application address including unit. Copy its words without abbreviating; formatting-tolerant for punctuation, case and whitespace.

occupancy_start.description: Date applicant starts occupying the dwelling, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; null if unresolved.

requested_start.description: Explicitly requested insurance start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; separate from occupancy date.

personal_property_limit.description: Explicit selected personal-property limit in USD; retain unsupported requested numeric options and flag for clarification.

liability_limit.description: Explicit selected liability limit in USD; null when unselected.

deductible.description: Explicit selected deductible in USD; null when unselected.

consent_to_submit.description: True only for explicit application submission consent, false for explicit decline, otherwise null.

application_reference.description: Exact customer-selected application reference from the supplied draft records.
